question: The 73rd Amendment of the Constitution enables the states with a population of less than 20 lakhs to have a minimum ______ structure in the local governance of the state.
solution:
The correct answer is__** two-tier.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **73rd Amendment of the Constitution** was passed in **1992 **to provide constitutional status to the** Panchayati Raj Institutions **(PRIs) and to strengthen the** local self-governance** in rural areas of India.
 
• The Amendment provides for a** three-tier structure** of local governance in states with a population of** more than 20 lakhs**, while states with a population of **less than 20 lakhs** can have a minimum **two-tier structure.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **two-tier structure** includes the **Gram Panchayats** at the village level and the **Panchayat Samiti **at the block level, while the** three-tier structure** includes the** Zilla Parishad** at the district level as the third tier.
 
• The purpose of the Amendment is to empower the **local communities** and to ensure their participation in **decision-making, planning and implementation** of developmental programs.
 
• **Union rule,** on the other hand, refers to the** central government's control **over the state governments, which is not related to the local governance structure.
